comparison.objective: Load a vial into a vacuum desiccator, restore vacuum, close the stopcock, and stop the pump; not commission a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Rate-controlled valve turning, dome handling, vial placement, gauge observation, sealing, and ordered controls versus key/collar adjustment.
comparison.success_condition: Vent rate at most 12 kPa/s, final pressure at or below -90 kPa, stopcock shut, pump off, powder undisturbed, seal retained. Candidate uses carriage-impact and lock-drift checks.
comparison.reason: Both include observed response and rotary control, but vacuum-system operation tests different physics and manipulation.
